nodes.text:
Human metapneumovirus (#HMPV) can cause respiratory disease. it's spreads from person to person or surfaces to person.

Symptoms are cough, fever, nasal congestion, and shortness of breath. 

Prevention measures include hand washing, cleaning surfaces, and staying home when sick.
